items.title: Maldive Gas to resume normal cooking gas supply from Saturday
items.summary: Maldive Gas introduced temporary restrictions on cylinder refills last Saturday following difficulties in obtaining sufficient supplies.

items.title: Small island states seek climate justice, not sympathy: President
items.summary: The President stressed that climate financing must be adequate, accessible, predictable and provided in the form of grants.

items.title: Loss of land threatens Maldives' sovereignty, president says
items.summary: During his address, President Muizzu outlined measures being pursued by the Maldives to strengthen its resilience to climate change.

items.title: Maldives' dollar revenue rises 6% to $1.3 billion in 10 months
items.summary: Tourism Goods and Services Tax (TGST) accounted for the largest share of dollar revenue, contributing USD 622.5 million, or 48% of total collection.

items.title: 3 arrested over alleged hostage-taking and assault at Malé café
items.summary: The Maldives Police Service confirmed on Thursday night that the arrests were made following an incident at a café on Maaveyo Magu.

items.title: MMA plans changes to medical dollar scheme amid misuse
items.summary: The Governor said the proposed measures would allow authorities to monitor the use of the foreign currency allocation more effectively.

items.title: MDP calls for withdrawal of charges against Thinadhoo mayor
items.summary: The party described the charges as politically motivated and without sufficient legal grounds.

items.title: Shamheed pledges to settle court-ordered bank debt personally
items.summary: The Civil Court ruled that five individuals, including Shamheed, were liable for outstanding payments under a USD 500,000 sale-and-leaseback financing.

items.title: Fenaka's unpaid supplier bills reach MVR 3.51B, audit reveals
items.summary: According to the audit, Fenaka recorded MVR 3.51 billion in outstanding payments for goods and services supplied as of 31 December 2024.

items.title: Court rules MDP presidential hopeful Shamheed liable for debt
items.summary: Failure to meet the constitutional qualifications can result in the loss of parliamentary membership.
